verdict.rationale: skills.sh is a skills registry and installer CLI, not an agent itself, so shipping an official MCP server would be a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence documents only CLI commands (add, use, list, find, update, remove, init) and the leaderboard site. Nothing shows an MCP server or hosted MCP endpoint that agents can connect to, and community mentions of MCP concern skill dependencies, not a skills.sh server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
